title: GATE Memory Quality Decision Event (C18)
description: Emitted by the C18 Data Quality Gate (Memory Gateway) for every retrieval. Captures the per-item decision against the signed quality bundle: freshness, confidence, and provenance gates. v1.4 adds source_registry_hash and feed_registry_hash to record the C04 source registry and approved feed registry state at the moment of the chain-check decision; both are optional so v1.1.1 fixture events validate cleanly.

request_hash.description: Hash of the originating MemoryRequest. Correlates the quality decision to the retrieval.

item_id.description: Stored item identifier (vector store ID, document ID, or equivalent).

content_class.description: Content class taxonomy key. Drives the per-class TTL, minimum confidence, and provenance-required configuration in the quality bundle.

freshness_age_seconds.description: Item age in seconds at retrieval time.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score recorded at write time. Semantics defined by the upstream pipeline. C18 enforces the per-class threshold; it does not compute the score.

provenance_uri.description: Resolvable external reference to the item's source. Self-referential URIs are not accepted.

provenance_hash_verified.description: True when the stored provenance_hash matches the hash of the source descriptor resolved from provenance_uri.

quality_bundle_hash.description: Hash of the signed quality bundle in force when this decision was made. Recorded so the decision is replayable.

source_registry_hash.description: Hash of the active C04 source registry state when this quality decision ran the chain check. Present when the provenance_uri used the gate-source:// scheme. Absent on v1.3 records and on decisions where the chain check did not consult the source registry.

feed_registry_hash.description: Hash of the active approved feed registry state when this quality decision ran the chain check. Present when the provenance_uri used the gate-feed:// scheme. Absent on v1.3 records and on decisions where the chain check did not consult the feed registry.

outcome.description: Resolved quality-gate outcome. Severity order: deny > downgrade > flag > pass.

flags_set.description: Quality flags returned alongside the item. Downstream consumers (agent runtime, prompt template, C13 trace) MUST honour these. v1.4 adds two flags: `provenance_unregistered` for the C18 chain-check case where a well-formed provenance_uri did not resolve against either the C04 source registry or the approved feed registry; `feed_registry_invariant_violation` for the case where the approved feed registry itself violated a structural invariant at query time (hash mismatch, expired entry, missing referenced feed).

quality_override.description: Present only when a break-glass override admitted an otherwise-denied retrieval. See memory_request.quality_override.
